title: Less AI-sounding Skills briefs
reader_summary: After Claude writes a Skills blurb, apply a light polish that strips common AI-writing tells without changing facts.
outcome_line: Measuring before: baseline 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-10 on Skills. Treatment starts 2026-10-11.
how_we_measure: Editorial rubric (specificity, why-now, accuracy) plus a short human-sounding spot-check. Token log is secondary (expect a small cost bump). Do not gate on PostHog CTR.

reader_glossary.meaning: A Claude Code skill (blader/humanizer) that detects named AI-writing patterns and rewrites prose without inventing facts. We did not install it. We copied the habit: one post-narration polish pass on Skills blurbs to strip filler and stock phrases while keeping README-grounded facts intact.

hypothesis: A post-narration Humanizer-style polish reduces AI-writing tells on Skills blurbs without hurting factual accuracy or Why-now hooks.
change_summary: Add DIGEST_HUMANIZER_POLISH=1 on both the OSS and Skills digest commands (post-narrate polish pass).
notes: Queued #2 after EXP-20260715-soft-dedup-diversity-skills. Inspired by blader/humanizer on Skills digests. Lab post: briefings/lab/posts/EXP-20260913-humanizer-polish-skills.md.
